summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of Da RoastBox clone with 40 personas. Backend: 72/72 pytest pass (67 existing + 5 new gap tests: deep diagnostics authenticated, p12 402, 11 SKUs, BYOK save/clear, BYOK empty 400). Frontend: splash 18+ gating, studio 40 cards (25 free/15 premium badges), all 40 portraits load (no broken images after load), new personas render with correct names, locked premium click -> toast + /credits, persona_22+persona_25 roast generated via UI (10 beats, all with OpenAI TTS audio served 200 audio/mpeg, free daily roast applied, credits unchanged at 5), credits page 11 SKUs with 15-roaster bundle tagline, Stripe checkout redirect AND full test-card payment (4242) -> /credits/success 'Premium Personas Unlocked' -> p12 becomes selectable in studio. Settings BYOK save/clear works with ACTIVE indicators + toast. Only 2 real roast generations total (1 pytest, 1 UI).

minor.issue: Any signed-in user (incl. dev-login users) can trigger live LLM + TTS calls repeatedly; no rate limit/admin gate -> cost-abuse vector in production.

issues: Large lock emoji overlay sits on top of the persona name, obscuring it (e.g. 'Big 🔒ny', 'Mam🔒azón') — move lock to image area or badge
Copy says 'OpenAI TTS with 6 spread voices across all 20 personas' — stale, should be 40 personas

Portraits are ~1MB each (≈24MB total for 40 cards), are JPEG data served with .png extension; on first load some premium images (e.g. persona_p4) were still incomplete after 3s. Recommend compressing to webp/~100KB thumbnails and loading='lazy'
